Name: Practical Barn and Coop
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

Practical Barn and Coop, refreshed, I  removed ruined wood because they were just built, and cleaned up a bit to make them prettier, added a small room for convenience, the small room has pet barrier so animals don't get in your way while you're working, and there's also a water source, for show, but it really works.
Now also recolored versions as an option configurable from Generic Mod Config Menu.

Enjoy!

Maybe you might be interested in my other [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/181358142?tab=user+files]Mods[/url]

If you appreciate my work could you buy me a coffee [url=https://ko-fi.com/kanacane]Ko fi[/url] ?
